from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u037/system/state/workspace/programs')
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=root/'task-cb0d806e.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] == color and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            bottom = max(y for y, x in cells)
            right = max(x for y, x in cells)
            crop = [[grid[y][x] for x in range(left, right+1)] for y in range(top, bottom+1)]
            objects.append((top, left, crop))
    horizontal = w >= h
    objects.sort(key=(lambda obj: obj[1]) if horizontal else (lambda obj: obj[0]))
    if horizontal:
        return [sum((obj[2][r] for obj in objects), []) for r in range(len(objects[0][2]))]
    return [row[:] for obj in objects for row in obj[2]]
'''
path.write_text(code)
print(path, path.exists())
